title: Manual check with a DAW: start on the bar, tempo changes, stop, peers leaving, latency
description:
## Intent
Check by ear, with a real DAW, what machines can't: the click and the DAW's metronome agree.

## Steps (macOS, record results as a comment)
1. In the DAW: turn Link on, turn Start Stop Sync on, set 124 BPM, metronome on.
2. `./target/release/apricity play <a score with a click or drum clip> --link`: it says "1 peer, 124 BPM" and waits.
3. Press play in the DAW: Apricity starts on the DAW's bar line; listen for flams between metronome and click for 2 minutes.
4. Change the DAW's tempo mid-bar to 98, then drag it slowly to 110: no flams; the re-warp lands on a bar line.
5. Stop and restart in the DAW; quit the DAW while Apricity plays (it keeps going); reopen the DAW (it joins at Apricity's tempo).
6. Repeat with the DAW on a second Mac on the same Wi-Fi.
7. Record latency: with a USB interface and with Bluetooth headphones, and whether `--latency` fixes the Bluetooth case.

## Verify
A comment on this task with each step's result (pass/fail, notes), the macOS and DAW versions, and any bug filed as a `bug` under M2.

Commit: none (manual check).
